model.name: Nano Banana 2.1
model.aspect: per job: 16:9 for sheets and plates, 9:16 for keyframes (set the chip per job; see RUN_NOTES.md)
model._note: Nano Banana 2.1 only, no fallback, always x2. Same rules as the Granth series.

style.text: Indian classical iconography and acting rendered as modern 2.5D cel-shaded anime: variable ink lines (thicker on the silhouette, thinner in folds), two cel tones plus one hard core-shadow plane, motivated rim light only where a visible low sun or bright water sits behind the figure, painterly depth layers with flat colour bands and aerial haze behind, Braj daylight earth palette.
style._note: ONE style entry. chip stays null until STYLE_CHIP_SHEET is accepted and uploaded under the chip name; then set chip to that exact name. Until then no style image is attached (the Granth lesson: a style picture leaks its content).

tail: Full-frame picture, edge to edge, no border, no inset. No text, no letters, no modern objects, no halo.

CHAR-KRISHNA.name: Bala Krishna (about 7-8 years old)
CHAR-KRISHNA.sentence: Krishna (attached CHAR-KRISHNA): a child of about 7-8 years old, 5.5 heads tall with child proportions (large head, short limbs, round belly), flat cloud-dark indigo-grey skin, wild dark curls pushed back with one peacock feather tucked at the side, golden pitambara tied at the waist, black Kali Kamli blanket tied as a tight wrestler's sash knotted at the waist, upper torso uncovered with the Srivatsa mark on the chest, exactly as in his character sheet; never a generic anime hero, never an adult, never saturated blue skin

ENV-KADAMBA-BANK.text: the black ash-sand bank of the Yamuna at dawn: the green grass line stops where the ash begins, one lone kadamba tree leans over the water with dark green leaves out of focus in the foreground, a Braj village far behind on the upper right, low sun from screen left, sky haze, flat painted bands of river and far bank with aerial haze

ENV-KALIYA-DAH-POISONED.text: a dark pool at the Yamuna bend seen from high above: black water, dead roots at the edge, muted violet and sick green fume bands in flat layers, hazed daylight with the sun dulled by miasma, colour drained toward grey-violet; no glowing neon vapour

PROP-KALI-KAMLI.sentence: the black Kali Kamli blanket tied as a tight wrestler's sash at his waist with its loose ends, exactly as in the attached costume detail sheet; never a belt or a logo sash

PROP-MOR-MUKUT.sentence: the single peacock feather tucked in his curls at the side, exactly as in the attached costume detail sheet; no crown
